description: This file defines the RowColumnInformation class which provides static methods to retrieve row and column information for cell references in spreadsheet calculations, such as COLUMN, ROW, COLUMNS, and ROWS functions.

classes.name: RowColumnInformation
classes.description: A utility class for retrieving row and column information from cell references in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: cellAddressNullOrWhitespace
methods.description: Checks if a cell address is null or a whitespace string.

methods.name: cellColumn
methods.description: Returns the column index of a given cell, or 1 if the cell is null.

methods.name: COLUMN
methods.description: Returns the column number(s) for a given cell or range, or the column of the current cell if omitted.

methods.name: COLUMNS
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in an array or reference.

methods.name: cellRow
methods.description: Returns the row number of a given cell, or 1 if null.

methods.name: ROW
methods.description: Returns the row number(s) for a given cell or range, or the row of the current cell if omitted.

methods.name: ROWS
methods.description: Returns the number of rows in an array or reference.
